gre_general.value: GRE is required unless you will already hold a degree from a US or Canadian institution by the time you enrol, so most applicants from India must sit it.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required for applicants who will have received a degree from an institution located in the U.S. or Canada by the time of enrollment.

also.quote: GRE General Test scores are not required for applicants who will have received a degree from an institution located in the U.S. or Canada by the time of enrollment.

supervisor.value: Admission is granted by the department, not to a faculty member's research group, so you do not need a supervisor's agreement to apply.
supervisor.quote: Tufts offers a PhD program in Computer Science, with admission granted at the department level, not to individual faculty members’ research groups.

deadline.value: The official page prints a day and month without a year (for example 'Fall: December 1 (final)'), so no Fall 2027 date is stated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: The official pages checked do not state that all or most admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: The official programme page does not say whether a bachelor's or a master's is needed.

notes: The Human-Robot Interaction doctorate is a joint PhD with Mechanical and ECE; its own page is not used for field values here. The programme lists machine-learning research areas, but no separate data-science, AI or ML PhD exists, so no datasci record. Competitive TOEFL 100 / IELTS 7.5 are not minimums and are not used. The official deadline 'Fall: December 15 (final)' has no year, so deadline is Not stated.
